description: Longueur réseau d'égouttage et de collecte is a dataset listed in Open Data Wallonie Bruxelles, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by IDELUX. Longueur d'égout et de collecteur par type de réseau et par station. Coverage: Province of Luxembourg (Wallonia). The portal files it under Agriculture, Environnement. Its keywords are égout, longueur, collecteur, réseau. The portal shows 26,604 records. The portal shows 2023-04-21 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Creative Commons - CC0 (http://www.opendefinition.org/licenses/cc-by/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support wastewater and sewer network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-www-odwb-be-portal.
